changelog: - **Topic environments come back up** (#2213). `infra/server/topic-deploy.sh` hardcoded bridge networking with `--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway`, which only reaches the database on a host whose MySQL listens on the docker bridge. The migrated box publishes MySQL on `127.0.0.1` alone, so every topic deploy since the cutover died on `P1001: Can't reach database server at host.docker.internal:3306` and no PR has had a working `pr<N>` environment. It now takes the same `NETWORK` switch `deploy-prod.sh` and `demo-refresh.sh` were given during the migration (default `host`; `bridge` retained for a host whose DB user is granted from the gateway). Second defect in the same script: `HOST` still built the pre-#2182 `crm-pr<N>.<domain>` name while the routing block 200 lines later built `pr<N>.<domain>`, so the container's `NEXTAUTH_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` named a host Caddy does not serve and sign-in on a topic env could not have worked either. `HOST` now follows `ENV_PREFIX` and `FQDN` is derived from it, so the two cannot drift apart again.
